findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?profil=gry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: klyo_publish_game, klyo_upload_package, klyo_release_version, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_scaffold, klyo_game_diagnostics, klyo_game_patch, klyo_add_post · Private data: klyo_publish_game, klyo_upload_package, klyo_update_game, klyo_release_rollback, klyo_release_version, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_scaffold, klyo_game_sdk, klyo_fix_game, klyo_game_diagnostics, klyo_game_files, klyo_game_patch, klyo_game_play · Public sink: klyo_publish_game, klyo_upload_package, klyo_update_game, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_stats, klyo_game_patch, klyo_game_play, klyo_game_translate, klyo_fill_game_form, klyo_add_post · Destructive: klyo_release_rollback, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_diagnostics, klyo_game_patch, klyo_game_play.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: before: "Wizytówka twórcy na games.klyo.pl: „o mnie” i hasło pod nazwą. PISZESZ TY: asystent właściciela, na JEGO planie AI; klyo nie uruchamia żadnego modelu. Bez `o_mnie` i `haslo` oddajemy obecną wizytówkę, wydane gry (jedyny materiał, z którego wolno pisać) i zasady. Z nimi zapisujemy przez to samo sito " → after: "The developer's profile card on games.klyo.pl: “about me” and the tagline under the name. YOU WRITE: the owner's assistant, on the owner's own AI plan; klyo runs no model. Without `o_mnie` and `haslo` we return the current card, the released games (the only material you may write from) and the rules"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
